components.name: Crew row
components.css: .ds-seat{display:grid;grid-template-columns:52px 1fr auto;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:10px 12px;background:#f1e4c8;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(22,22,22,.16);font:800 16px/1.2 'Golos Text',sans-serif;color:#161616}.ds-seat b{font:900 26px/1 Unbounded,sans-serif;color:#d6372b}.ds-seat small{display:block;font:500 12px/1.3 'Spline Sans Mono',monospace;color:#4b4a52}.ds-seat em{font:600 13px/1 'Spline Sans Mono',monospace;font-style:normal;padding:5px 8px;background:#e6d3ad}

components.name: Stage
components.description: One stage of the flight-plan rocket; the burning one turns orange.
components.css: .ds-stage{display:grid;grid-template-columns:120px 48px 1fr;align-items:center;background:#1f2f8a;color:#f1e4c8;padding:12px}.ds-stage span{display:grid;place-items:center;height:90px;background:#ff7a1a;color:#161616;border:4px solid #161616;font:900 36px/1 Unbounded,sans-serif}.ds-stage i{height:2px;background:#f1e4c8}.ds-stage p{margin:0 0 0 12px;font:500 15px/1.3 'Spline Sans Mono',monospace}.ds-stage b{display:block;font:900 20px/1.05 Unbounded,sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase}

narrative.overview: A 1960s space-race poster you scroll through: flat red, paper and ultramarine fields cut on the diagonal, one orbit arc drawn across the page, over a light-cartoon 3D planet with a rocket that lifts off at the end.
keyCharacteristics: Circles only for people and planets
Burn orange only for what is firing now

rules.name: The One Burn Rule
rules.body: Burn orange marks one thing at a time: the stage firing now, the fuel held, the flame.

rules.name: The Wide Caps Rule
rules.body: Unbounded only at 15px and up, uppercase, never for sentences.

dos: Do keep every number in Spline Sans Mono
Do cut sheets and buttons on one corner
Do keep 3D subjects clear of the sheet beside them
donts: Don't add glows, neon or gradients to UI fields
Don't use burn orange for decoration
Don't add a kicker above a headline
Don't put a CSS transition on a GSAP-animated element
